entries.decision: Canonical numeral 5. Replaces legacy cin, which depended on removed letter c.

Canonical FAC- family root. Replaces legacy fac-. Legacy forms built on fac- must use the confirmed fak- root when their derivational morphology is retained; the derivational suffix inventory is reviewed separately.
Keep spelling major. Under the current alphabet j is the glide /j/, so canonical pronunciation is /ma.jor/, not legacy /madzh-or/.
Canonical verbal root for 'dire'. The regular participial/resultative is dikit via productive -it; legacy dict is not the verbal root.
